d:
Translation and typesetting are done automatically with AI. I found a way to fully automate comic translation with AI, and for this reason I wanted to share all the translations I "make". Feel free to also request translations of popular works that have never been translated over the years.

Don't get me wrong: the translation is only good enough for general understanding, and the typesetting is not much better either. I do not edit the final output at all, nor do I know how to do so.

To be clear, I will be publishing works that have gone untranslated in English for months or even years. The reason I am doing this is that I personally would love to read many works that have no translation, and I want to give people the opportunity to read these works even if the translation is not that good.
